# Cursor BYOK v1.0.5

## 更新内容

- 支持设置费用额度，在总览查看已用金额和额度进度。
- 总览新增模型和供应商用量趋势与活动总费用，按供应商配置归组统计。指标、图表和额度进度条更新时带有动画。
- 可分别设置总览和调用记录的自动刷新间隔，也可暂停总览自动刷新并按需手动刷新。
- 供应商设置支持自定义图标，可从上游获取并验证图标。
- 改进 Gemini 流式工具调用的组装，保留请求失败时的错误详情。

## Changes

- Configure spending limits and track spending against them in the overview.
- View usage trends for top models and providers, see total activity costs, and group provider statistics by configuration. Overview metrics, charts, and spending progress animate as they update.
- Set separate refresh intervals for the overview and call history. Pause automatic overview refresh and refresh manually when needed.
- Customize provider icons by fetching and validating icons from upstream sources.
- Improve how Gemini streamed tool calls are assembled and preserve error details when requests fail.
